mapper.sql: select ccue_llave as key ,ccue_catalogo as catalog ,ccue_wbs as wbs ,ccue_nombre as name ,ccue_codigo as code ,ccue_padre as parent ,ncue_nivel as level ,ccue_tipo as type ,ccue_naturaleza as operation ,ccue_documento as document ,ccue_estado as state from account.cuenta_cue a
mapper.select: where ccue_estado = 'A' and ccue_catalogo = #{catalog} and ccue_padre = #{parent} and upper(ccue_codigo) = upper(#{code}) union select cind_llave as key ,#{catalog} as catalog ,null as wbs ,cind_nombre as name ,cind_codigo as code ,null as parent ,1 as level ,'O' as type ,'D' as operation ,null as document ,cind_estado as state from account.indicador_ind ii where cind_estado = 'A' and upper(cind_codigo) = upper(#{code})

where ccue_llave = #{id} union select cind_llave as key ,'D3' as catalog ,null as wbs ,cind_nombre as name ,cind_codigo as code ,null as parent ,1 as level ,'O' as type ,'D' as operation ,null as document ,cind_estado as state from account.indicador_ind ii where cind_llave = #{id}

update account.cuenta_cue set ccue_catalogo = #{catalog}, ccue_wbs = #{wbs}, ccue_nombre = #{name}, ccue_codigo = #{code}, ccue_padre = #{parent}, ncue_nivel = #{level}, ccue_tipo = #{type}, ccue_naturaleza = #{operation}, ccue_documento = #{document}, ccue_estado =#{state}
